comments.author: akihironitta
comments.body: I believe this is a limitation by TorchScript since `|` type was not supported by TorchScript (at least in the past), but looking at https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/109293, it looks like they added support for it in PyTorch 2.2+? Given https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/109293#issuecomment-1732818938 and TorchScript being not developed actively anymore in favor of `torch.compile`, I'd suggest simply using `Optional`, or probably decorating your method with `torch.jit.unused` should allow you to avoid the error if you'd like to keep using `|`.

comments.author: akihironitta
comments.body: Closing this issue because TorchScript has been unmaintained for 3+ years, and PyTorch 2.9 has deprecated its support in favor of PT2 stack.
